api.name: guild
api.signature: guild: { id: string, name: string, memberCount: number }
api.description: Access metadata of the current guild/server.

api.name: channel
api.signature: channel: { id: string, name: string } | null
api.description: The channel where the script was triggered. Null if run in a background schedule or event without context.

api.name: invoker
api.signature: invoker: { id: string, tag: string } | null
api.description: The Discord member who ran the script. Null if triggered by a schedule or event.

api.name: members
api.description: List of cached members in the guild. MemberView properties: `.has_role(name)`, `.joined_days_ago`, `.mention`, `.role_names`.

api.name: roles
api.description: List of roles in the guild. RoleSnapshot has: `{ id: string, name: string }`.

api.name: channels
api.description: List of channels in the guild. ChannelSnapshot has: `{ id: string, name: string }`.

api.name: now
api.description: The current time as epoch milliseconds.

api.name: form
api.description: Map of values collected from the input form (declared using `input.*`).

api.name: find_role
api.description: Resolves a guild role by its name, mention, or raw ID.

api.name: find_member
api.description: Resolves a guild member by their user tag, mention, or raw ID.

api.name: members_with_role
api.description: Returns all guild members who hold the specified role.

api.name: member.add_role
api.description: Adds a role to this member. The argument can be a role name, mention, or ID.

api.name: member.remove_role
api.description: Removes a role from this member. The argument can be a role name, mention, or ID.

api.name: member.dm
api.description: Sends a private DM to this member.

api.name: createChannel
api.description: Creates a text or voice channel in the guild.

api.name: createRole
api.signature: createRole(opts: { name: string; color?: number }): void
api.description: Creates a role in the guild with an optional color.

api.name: title
api.description: Sets the title heading at the top of the script result card.

api.name: sep
api.description: Draws a visible separator line between output sections.

api.name: footer
api.description: Sets a small muted caption at the bottom of the script result card.

api.name: field
api.description: Adds a key-value detail row to the result card.

api.name: display
api.description: Renders plain text description in the result card.
api.example: return [display("No changes were made to the server.")];

api.name: color
api.description: Configures the accent color strip on the results panel.

api.name: input.text
api.description: Declares a single-line text input field in the runner form.

api.name: input.number
api.description: Declares a number input field in the runner form.

api.name: input.role
api.description: Declares a native Discord role picker field in the runner form.

api.name: input.member
api.description: Declares a native Discord member picker field in the runner form.

api.name: input.channel
api.description: Declares a native Discord channel picker field in the runner form.

api.name: fail_input
api.description: Rejects the form inputs and halts execution, displaying the custom validation message so the user can correct it.
